# Rolando Quinonez — Cybersecurity Portfolio

> Cybersecurity graduate and U.S. Army veteran. Hands-on projects across SOC authentication analysis, IAM & Active Directory administration, and GRC risk documentation, with honest, evidence-qualified status for each.

## Pages
- [Portfolio home](https://ronealqs2.github.io/): overview, projects, skills with sources, professional experience, public résumé overview, education & credentials.
- [Project collection](https://ronealqs2.github.io/projects/): the three projects side by side with skills in context.
- [SOC Authentication Analysis](https://ronealqs2.github.io/projects/soc.html): Windows authentication-event review (4624/4625), one controlled incorrect-password test, open domain-controller investigation. Home lab, in progress; SIEM planned.
- [IAM & Active Directory](https://ronealqs2.github.io/projects/iam.html): OUs, employee account provisioning, security groups, domain login, 900-second screen-lock policy check. Home lab, in progress.
- [Sentinel GRC Assessment](https://ronealqs2.github.io/projects/grc.html): fictional assessment with four provisional risks linked to proposed controls, planned evidence requests and remediation actions. Deliverables complete; validation pending.
